forbidden.comment: A service holds the logic a router, a worker or a test calls; one that imports a router depends on HTTP and cannot be called from anything else. plan:rulebearing-fastapi
forbidden.fix: Raise a domain exception in the service and translate it to an HTTPException in the router; move shared request types into schemas/.
forbidden.name: fastapi-services-not-to-routers

forbidden.comment: A repository is the lowest layer: it knows the database and the models, not the logic or the HTTP layer that calls it. plan:rulebearing-fastapi
forbidden.fix: Return data from the repository and let the service decide what to do with it; move the shared type into models/ or schemas/.
forbidden.name: fastapi-repositories-not-to-services-or-routers

forbidden.comment: A router that calls a repository directly puts business logic in the HTTP layer, where a worker or a test cannot reach it. plan:rulebearing-fastapi
forbidden.fix: Add a service function that calls the repository and call it from the router; inject it with Depends().
forbidden.name: fastapi-routers-through-services

forbidden.comment: Models and schemas are data every layer shares; one that imports a router, a service or a repository makes that a cycle. plan:rulebearing-fastapi
forbidden.fix: Move the behaviour into a service and keep the model or schema a plain declaration; a validator that needs a lookup belongs in the service.
forbidden.name: fastapi-models-and-schemas-are-innermost
